_(Optional)_ The shell interpreters whose `-c` operand is reported as an `'embedded-command'`<!-- -->. Defaults to [DEFAULT\_EMBEDDED\_COMMAND\_INTERPRETERS](./sh-analysis.default_embedded_command_interpreters.md)<!-- -->. Pass a replacement array to add or drop interpreters; an empty array disables the behavior, so every interpreter resolves as an ordinary effective command.

Validated at the [resolveArgv0()](./sh-analysis.resolveargv0.md) boundary like [ResolveArgv0Options.transparentWrappers](./sh-analysis.resolveargv0options.transparentwrappers.md)<!-- -->: the table must be an array. A non-array value (including `null`<!-- -->) or malformed entry throws [ShAnalyzeInvalidWrapperSpecError](./sh-analysis.shanalyzeinvalidwrapperspecerror.md)<!-- -->; only `undefined` uses defaults.

</td><td>

_(Optional)_ The transparent-wrapper table to follow. Defaults to [DEFAULT\_TRANSPARENT\_WRAPPERS](./sh-analysis.default_transparent_wrappers.md)<!-- -->. Pass a replacement array to drop a default entry entirely (that wrapper is then treated as an ordinary, non-transparent effective command), or add project-specific entries (e.g. a `with-retry` wrapper) — the table is plain data, not baked-in policy.

Only omission or `undefined` selects defaults; an empty array deliberately disables wrapper following. A supplied table must be an array with a valid non-null object at every position, and flag arrays must contain strings in every slot. Non-array containers (including `null`<!-- -->), missing table/field elements and malformed entries throw [ShAnalyzeInvalidWrapperSpecError](./sh-analysis.shanalyzeinvalidwrapperspecerror.md) before command matching rather than becoming defaults or native failures.

</td></tr>
